prompt: Create a photorealistic cinematic street scene in modern Tokyo on a clear sunny day: a massive humanoid police patrol robot, about three stories tall, walks down a narrow residential road between apartment buildings. The robot is bulky and highly detailed, built from white armor plates over black mechanical joints, pistons, cables, bolts, vents, and exposed hydraulics, with a rectangular sensor head packed with multiple camera lenses. It has Japanese police markings on its chest and shoulders reading 「警視庁」 and “MPD,” and smaller “MPD” markings on its legs. The robot is friendly rather than threatening, standing in the left-center foreground with one huge articulated hand raised in a wave toward residents. On the right, a beige multi-story apartment building with metal balcony railings fills the frame; exactly four visible people wave back from balconies: one boy on an upper balcony, and three children on a lower balcony. Include laundry poles, balcony details, potted greenery, roadside shrubs, utility poles, overhead wires, a small urban street receding into the background, parked bicycles, lane markings, and hard midday shadows. Use a low-angle wide lens perspective from street level, realistic scale, sharp focus, natural Japanese residential textures, blue sky, high dynamic range, documentary realism, no anime styling, no extra text beyond the robot markings. Customize the robot unit as 警視庁 MPD, the city setting as Tokyo residential street, the waving residents as four children on apartment balconies, the time of day as clear sunny midday, and the mood as friendly neighborhood patrol.

promptZh: 创建一个超写实的电影级东京现代街景，天气晴朗：一个约三层楼高的巨型人形警用巡逻机器人正走在公寓楼之间狭窄的住宅街道上。机器人体型庞大且细节丰富，由覆盖在黑色机械关节、活塞、线缆、螺栓、通风口和外露液压系统上的白色装甲板构成，头部为长方形传感器阵列，配备多个摄像头镜头。其胸部和肩部印有日本警方的标识“警视庁”和“MPD”，腿部则印有较小的“MPD”字样。机器人显得友好而非威胁，位于画面左中前景，一只巨大的机械手抬起向居民挥手。画面右侧是一栋带有金属阳台栏杆的米色多层公寓楼，清晰可见四个人正在阳台上挥手回应：上层阳台有一名男孩，下层阳台有三名儿童。画面包含晾衣杆、阳台细节、盆栽绿植、路边灌木、电线杆、架空电线、向背景延伸的小型城市街道、停放的自行车、车道标线以及正午时分强烈的阴影。采用从街道水平拍摄的低角度广角镜头，比例写实，焦点清晰，呈现自然的日本住宅质感，蓝天背景，高动态范围，纪录片式的写实风格，无动漫风格，除机器人标识外无额外文字。自定义机器人单元为 警视庁 MPD，城市背景为 东京住宅街道，挥手的居民为 公寓阳台上的四名儿童，时间为 晴朗的正午，氛围为 友好的社区巡逻。
